fact: A notice of 28 September 2026 seeks market views on a sovereign cloud to host the national interoperability platform (X-Road) and sized for inter-administration exchange volumes, stating that implementing the X-Road platform itself is a separate initiative outside its scope.
title: Avis d'engagement précoce du marché: fourniture, installation, intégration et mise en exploitation des infrastructures numériques (WARDIP-GN)
publisher: Ministère de la Communication, de l'Économie numérique et de l'Innovation (MCENI), WARDIP-GN
